dedupe_keys.name: gfdrr country climate and disaster risk screening tools

description: The World Bank's GFDRR Country Climate and Development Report tools are scripted workflows for subnational climate and disaster risk screening. They combine global flood, cyclone or custom hazard layers with exposure and poverty information, extract climate anomalies by administrative unit, and present results in maps and a dashboard. Users supply a country area, hazard datasets, administrative boundaries and screening choices; outputs are risk indicators and maps for the selected place and scenario period. Geographic coverage depends on the available global source layers and country inputs. The repository publishes documentation and GPL-3.0 source; a separate commercial licence is offered for proprietary use. A limitation is that screening from global layers is not a substitute for local engineering hazard maps or facility-level loss models. The tools can frame infrastructure vulnerability studies across roads, water and energy. The catalogue's data-worldpop-global-gridded-population is a distinct possible exposure layer. No hazard dataset or dashboard package was downloaded.
